title: .kbl.json keyboard layout, version 0.2 (draft)
description: A YAKBD keyboard-layout file. Normative text: SPEC.md; this schema checks structure only (SPEC §19 lists further rules).

id.description: BCP 47 tag identifying this keyboard (CLDR keyboard3/@locale); its language is the primary locale.

locales.description: Further BCP 47 tags of supported languages, in order (CLDR locales).

localizedNames.description: The name in further languages, per BCP 47 tag.

attribution.description: Originating entity of the design (CLDR info/@attribution).

layoutPattern.description: Layout pattern such as QWERTY (CLDR info/@layout).

version.description: Version of the layout data; Semantic Versioning recommended (CLDR version/@number).

license.description: SPDX licence expression for the layout data.

cldrImports.description: CLDR import paths that were inlined (cldr: prefix for base=cldr).

provenance.description: Informative record of where the data came from; never changes behaviour.

capsLockFallback.description: With Caps Lock on and no binding in the matched layer, resolve again without Caps Lock (default true).

capsLockOffBy.description: What turns Caps Lock off: capsLock (default) or shift (Shift Lock).

bidiMarksOnShiftBackspace.description: Left/right Shift + Backspace type LRM/RLM (default false).

scanCode.description: Set-1 scan code: 2 hex digits, or E0xx / E1xx.

name.description: The key's display name (Windows key names, .klc KEYNAME).

numLock.description: The key is a number-pad key subject to Num Lock (SPEC §14.1).

rows.description: Rows top to bottom, each a list of positions left to right.

items.description: The XML text of one <special> element.

cldrSpecial.description: Complete XML text of each CLDR <special> element whose parent corresponds to this form, in document order (SPEC §18).

propertyNames.description: A modifier component: shift, ctrl, ctrlL, ctrlR, alt, altL, altR, caps, other, or a name declared in customModifiers (SPEC §7).

kind.description: held: active while held; lock: toggled.

fallback.description: lock only: with the lock on and no binding in the matched layer, resolve again without it (SPEC §9.3). Default true.

deadKey.description: The key is this dead key.

gap.description: The key is empty space (CLDR key/@gap).

width.description: Width in key units, default 1 (CLDR key/@width).

stretch.description: May be stretched in a touch row (CLDR key/@stretch).

layerId.description: Switches the touch layout to this layer (CLDR key/@layerId).

function.description: Informative identity of a touch key.

additionalProperties.description: A CLDR key: an output with gestures (SPEC §8).

keys.description: CLDR's bag of keys by KeyId (SPEC §8).

formId.description: The form the layout was designed on (CLDR layers/@formId).

modifiers.description: The modifier sets this layer serves.

bindings.description: Binding per position; an absent position does nothing in this layer.

items.description: The XML text of one <special> element.

cldrSpecial.description: Complete XML text of each CLDR <special> element whose parent corresponds to this layer, in document order (SPEC §18).

cldrSpecial.description: Complete XML text of each CLDR <special> element whose parent corresponds to the hardware layers element, in document order (SPEC §18).

spacing.description: Text the dead key stands for when it does not combine; default Windows dead character.

name.description: Name of the dead key (.klc KEYNAME_DEAD).

base.description: The input that composes: text, another dead key, or code units.

result.description: The result: text, a chained dead key, or code units.

entries.description: Composition table in order; first match wins.

noMatch.description: Behaviour when the next input has no entry (default emitBoth).

display.description: Key-cap text if different from spacing.

output.description: Output whose keys get this cap.

keyId.description: The key that gets this cap.

items.description: One rule: for keys with this output, or for the key keyId.

baseCharacter.description: Base for combining marks instead of U+25CC.

cldrSpecial.description: Complete XML text of each CLDR <special> element whose parent corresponds to displays, in document order (SPEC §18).

keyboard.description: File name of the tested keyboard.

type.description: How the characters must be typeable.

locks.description: Locks on: caps, custom lock components.

keystroke.description: A CLDR key press with optional gesture, or a hardware position press.

check.description: Expected text before the insertion point.

useTableA.description: false: rule vk uses no Table A at all, the file's VKs are exactly its pins (default true; targets/windows.md §5).

component.description: The kbl component it stands for.

modNumber.description: ModNumber: column per bit combination (index), null = SHFT_INVALID.

kanaLockComponent.description: The custom lock that is Windows' Kana lock (KANALOK).

vk.description: Virtual key of the position (rule vk).

items.description: KBDEXT, KBDMULTIVK, KBDSPECIAL, KBDNUMPAD, KBDUNICODE, KBDINJECTEDVK, KBDMAPPEDVK, KBDBREAK.

width.description: Number of columns of the table.

rows.description: Rows in order: a position, or a VK of extraRows.

extraRows.description: Rows for VKs no position produces.

character.description: The dead character, one unit (rule deadCharacter).

additionalProperties.description: Windows data of one dead key.

productCode.description: Product GUID, {XXXXXXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXXXXXXXXXX}: ownership marker, uninstall-entry key, upgrade identity (rule productCode, targets/windows-install.md §2).

registration.description: Registry data for the installer (rule registration).

enableForUser.description: Add the layout to the installing user's input list (rule enableForUser, default true).

enableForSignInAndNewUsers.description: Also add the layout to the sign-in screen and to accounts created later (rule enableForSignInAndNewUsers, default false; targets/windows-install.md §7.1).

productName.description: Display name of the uninstall entry (rule uninstallEntry).

productVersion.description: Version shown in the uninstall entry, free text (rule uninstallEntry).

publisher.description: Publisher of the uninstall entry (rule uninstallEntry).

dispatcher.description: Multi-table dispatcher data: carried, not compiled.

msklcEditorCompatible.description: Write only what the MSKLC editor keeps (default false).

carryInSpecial.description: Carry kbl-only data in a <special> element (default true).

layoutName.description: Layout name: keyboard/@name, the .keylayout and .icns file names, the KLInfo_<name> key (rule layoutName).

bundleName.description: Bundle folder name without .bundle, and CFBundleName (rule bundleName).

inputSourceId.description: TISInputSourceID, the input-source id the system selects by (rule inputSourceId).

localizedNames.description: Localised layout names, one InfoPlist.strings per language (rule localizedNames).

icns.description: The .icns file, base64 (RFC 4648 §4, no line breaks).

template.description: TISIconIsTemplate: the icon is a template image the system tints. Default false.

icon.description: The layout's icon, Resources/<layoutName>.icns (no default: the system's generic icon).

group.description: keyboard/@group, the script code; 126 = Unicode (rule group).

id.description: keyboard/@id; Unicode layouts use negative ids (rule keyboardId).

maxout.description: keyboard/@maxout: most UTF-16 units one key press emits (rule maxout).

hardwareRanges.description: The <layout> elements, in order, all selecting the one key map set (rule hardwareRanges).

standardKeys.description: true: unbound standard keys (Return, Tab, arrows, …) get the outputs of the position table (rule standardKeys, default true).

commandMap.description: States with Command that no layer serves: the table of the same state without Command, or the base table (rule commandMap).

controlMap.description: States with Control that no layer serves: the table without Control with ASCII letters turned into U+0001–U+001A, that table unchanged, or no output (rule controlMap).

command.description: The custom held component that is the Command key.

modifiers.description: Which custom components are macOS modifier keys.

state.description: The dead key's state name (rule stateName).

additionalProperties.description: macOS data of one dead key.

symbolsName.description: The symbols file name and the layout name in rules/evdev.xml (rule symbolsName).

variant.description: The section name: basic (default) is the file's default section and a layout of its own; any other name is a variant of the layout symbolsName (rule variant).

description.description: The layout's name: name[Group1] and the registry's <description> (rule description).

shortDescription.description: The registry's <shortDescription>, the short label of the layout (rule shortDescription).

languages.description: The registry's <languageList>, three-letter codes; no default (none written).

characters.description: How characters are written in the symbols file: keysym names and Uxxxx (any libxkbcommon, xkbcomp) or UTF-8 strings (libxkbcommon 1.9 and later only) (rule characters).

keyName.description: The XKB key name, without the angle brackets (rule keyName).

oneOf.description: A stock key type of xkeyboard-config (targets/xkb.md §3).
A yakbd key type: YAKBD_ and the level of each of the 8 (or 16, with LevelFive) states, Lock always consumed (targets/xkb.md §3).

type.description: The key type of this key (rule keyType).

customTypes.description: true: a key no stock type fits gets a yakbd key type, installed with the layout (needs libxkbcommon 1.13 or a types option on X11); default false (rule keyType).

levelThree.description: The component that is the level-3 shift: altR, alt or a custom held component (rule levelThree).

levelFive.description: The component that is the level-5 shift: a custom held component or altR; no default (no level 5).

keysym.description: The dead_* keysym the dead key's key types (rule deadKeysym).

additionalProperties.description: XKB data of one dead key.

write.description: Write a Compose file with the dead-key sequences (default: when the file has dead keys).

includeLocale.description: Start the Compose file with include "%L", keeping the system sequences (default true).

compose.description: The Compose file of the build (rule compose).

propertyNames.description: An absolute URI or reverse-DNS name.

extensions.description: Data of other tools, by URI or reverse-DNS name (SPEC §18).

items.description: The XML text of one <special> element.

cldrSpecial.description: Complete XML text of each CLDR <special> element whose parent corresponds to keyboard3 (and keys, flicks, variables with a kbl:parent comment), in document order (SPEC §18).

Text.description: Text (SPEC §2.1): a JSON string of Unicode scalar values; no lone surrogates.

PositionId.description: A position id (SPEC §2.5, §6.1); W3C UI Events code values are recommended.

Id.description: A KeyId, FlickId, LayerId, DeadKeyId, MarkerId or FormId (SPEC §2.5).

oneOf.description: The value of a string variable (SPEC §13.1).

MarkedText.description: MarkedText (SPEC §2.3): a Text, or an array of Texts, markers and string variables.

items.description: A modifier component: shift, ctrl, ctrlL, ctrlR, alt, altL, altR, caps, other, or a name declared in customModifiers (SPEC §7).

ModifierSet.description: A modifier set (SPEC §7.1): components active together; [] means none, ["other"] means no other layer matches.

Modifiers.description: The modifier sets a layer serves (CLDR's comma-separated layer/@modifiers).

oneOf.description: Shorthand: the key emits this Text.
The key behaves as this Key of `keys` (or an implied key).
The key is this dead key.

Binding.description: What a position does in a layer (SPEC §9.2).

utf16.description: The UTF-16 code units, each four hex digits.

CodeUnits.description: CodeUnits (SPEC §2.2): exact UTF-16 code units, for values a Text cannot hold (Windows).

TextOrUnits.description: A Text or a CodeUnits value.

Pattern.description: A CLDR transform/reorder pattern or variable value, verbatim in CLDR syntax (SPEC §2.4).

WinCell.description: A Windows table cell of an extra row: Text, CodeUnits, a dead key, or null (WCH_NONE).

LangIdText.description: Text per Windows LANGID (four hex digits).

Policy.description: error: the build or conversion fails; warning: reported; accept: reported as accepted.

default.description: Policy for kinds not listed in `kinds`.

propertyNames.description: A loss kind of SPEC §17.3, a prefix wildcard, or <target>Default.<rule>.

kinds.description: Policy per loss kind, per `<prefix>.*`, or per defaulted-choice kind `<target>Default.<rule>`.
